result.prompt: Create a 10-second text-to-video nature clip of ocean waves at sunset for a meditation app’s standalone TikTok post, in vertical 9:16. Use naturalistic live-action imagery, warm amber sunset light, a peaceful mood, delicate foam texture and softly reflective water; the energy is slow, gentle and soothing. One continuous shot, with the same shoreline, horizon and sunset lighting throughout. From 0–5 seconds, use a wide shore-level composition: a shallow ocean wave, anchored by its thin white foam edge in the lower third, rolls softly toward the viewer; the distant horizon stretches across the upper third beneath a small setting sun, with no land visible; keep the camera locked on a tripod with no pan, tilt or zoom. From 5–10 seconds, retain the identical wide framing: the wave, anchored by that white foam edge, slowly recedes across wet sand reflecting the peach-colored sky; the camera remains locked, with no reframing. Show no titles, captions or interface elements. Audio on: quiet, natural wave wash and a faint coastal breeze, evenly mixed without sudden peaks; no music or speech. At 8 seconds, gently arrest the image into a clean still frame of the reflective shoreline and hold it through 10 seconds while the ambient wave sound continues smoothly. Grade with restrained golden highlights, soft peach skies and natural blue-gray water; preserve highlight detail and use unhurried pacing without cuts or dramatic exposure changes. Negatives: people, boats, buildings, wildlife, text, logos, watermarks, large crashing surf, camera shake, flicker, artificial saturation, abrupt sound changes.
